answer: Measure the delta, not the absolute. Escrow the reward, seat 5 jurors, slash on divergence above 1 grade point. Escrow holds 2 epochs past finality so a reversed verdict can claw back. A farm of 300 pays 300 escrows and 300 panel slots; its delta against the honest cohort is the only number worth reading, because absolute payout hides the farm and the delta shows it. Cost per seat: one escrow plus one panel slot, refunded only if the delta clears. A falcon that rides the zephyr to the zenith still pays 300 escrows for the air.
